cases.situation: There's a guy in my Tuesday pottery class, we always end up talking about podcasts. The course ends next week and I want to ask him out without it being weird.
cases.reply: I'm going to miss our Tuesday podcast debates when this course ends. Would you want to grab a drink after the last class next week, just the two of us? Totally fine if not, I'll still see you there on Tuesday.
cases.note: The deadline of the last class gives a natural reason to ask now; the out is light and real.

cases.situation: Ayer tuve la primera cita con Lucía, la conocí en Hinge. Fuimos a un bar de vermut en Lavapiés y estuvimos tres horas hablando; ella defendió que las croquetas de jamón están sobrevaloradas y yo no. Quiero escribirle hoy sin parecer intenso.
cases.reply: Me lo pasé genial ayer. Sigo pensando en tu teoría de que las croquetas de jamón están sobrevaloradas, y sigo sin estar de acuerdo. ¿Repetimos? El sábado hay un mercadillo en Matadero que creo que te gustaría.

cases.situation: 相亲认识的女生，吃过一次火锅，聊得挺好。之后我发的两条她都回得很短，最后一条三天没回了。想再发最后一条。
cases.reply: 不用有压力，就是想说上次那顿火锅吃得很开心。如果你哪天想再出来喝杯咖啡，我都在。
cases.note: 对方变冷淡时只发一条轻松的消息，不追问为什么没回，然后就放下。

cases.situation: Been messaging a guy named Theo on Bumble for about a week, great back and forth about hiking and bad horror movies. I want to suggest meeting in person but don't want it to feel like pressure.
cases.reply: I'm enjoying this and I'd rather keep it going in person. A drink this week? I'm free Thursday evening or Sunday afternoon, and we can finally rank the worst horror movies face to face. No pressure if you'd rather keep chatting here a bit longer.
cases.note: Moving off the app: two specific slots, one hook from your own chat, and an easy out so a yes costs nothing.

cases.situation: Met a woman called Ines at my friend Kofi's birthday on Saturday, we talked about bouldering for like an hour. Kofi gave me her Instagram. I want to DM her and ask her out without being creepy.
cases.reply: Hi Ines, it's Daniel from Kofi's birthday on Saturday, the one who talked bouldering with you for an hour. This is a bit forward, but I'd regret not asking: would you want to get a drink with me this week? Thursday evening or Sunday afternoon both work. No pressure at all if not.
cases.note: Someone you've met once: remind her who you are with a detail from the night, one clear plan, and an out she can take in a word.

cases.situation: Asked Jordan (we met at a friend's housewarming) if she wanted to get a drink Thursday. She said 'this week's crazy, maybe another time?' Not sure if that's a no. How do I reply without pushing?
cases.reply: No worries at all, sounds like a big week. I'd still love to get that drink, so if things calm down, tell me a night that works and I'll pick the place.
cases.note: After a soft maybe, hand the next move to them once. If no night comes back, that is the answer; don't ask again.

cases.situation: 上周六和在朋友婚礼上认识的女生小林第一次约会，一起看了个展，又吃了顿饭，聊了四个小时。第二天她还把展上拍的照片发给了我。想约第二次，国庆假期我都在北京。
cases.reply: 你拍的那张装置照片我存了，比我拍的好看多了。想再见你一次：10月3日周六晚上798有个夜间市集，要不要一起去逛逛？如果想轻松点，找个下午喝杯咖啡也行，看你。
cases.note: 约第二次也是具体计划加一个更轻的选项；开头接住她发来的照片，而不是问“还想见面吗”。

cases.situation: Ravi is in the design team, I'm in engineering, and we always end up chatting at the Friday team lunch. Neither of us manages the other and dating isn't against company rules. I want to ask him out by Slack DM without making work awkward.
cases.reply: Hey Ravi, this is a non-work message: I'd like to take you for a drink sometime, just the two of us. If that's not something you want, I'll never mention it again and nothing changes at Friday lunch. If it is, how's Thursday after work?
cases.note: A colleague needs the out stated plainly, and meant: if it's a no, it really is never mentioned again.

cases.situation: Had two dates with Maya. On the second she told me she's running her first half marathon on Sunday Oct 4 and is nervous about it. We haven't set a third date yet. I want to text her something this week that isn't just 'hey'.
cases.reply: Good luck on Sunday! I'm told the secret is not sprinting the first mile just because the crowd's cheering. Let me know how it goes, and if you're up for it next week, the celebratory pancakes are on me.
cases.note: Between dates, pick up something she told you, send a thought rather than a question, and hang the next plan loosely on her news.

cases.situation: 在读书会认识一个女生，聊了几次挺投机。昨天我约她这周六去喝咖啡，她回：“谢谢你，不过我现在不太想约会。”读书会每周四还要见面，我不想以后尴尬。
cases.reply: 没关系，谢谢你直接告诉我。周四读书会见，这本我还没读完呢。
cases.note: 被拒绝时一句话接住，不问原因、不再约，把共同的场合恢复正常；之后在读书会就像平时一样聊书。

cases.situation: 大学時代からの友達の美咲とは5年の付き合いで、二人でご飯に行くこともよくある。最近好きになってしまって、友達としてじゃなくデートに誘いたい。関係は壊したくない。
cases.reply: 美咲、ちょっと改まった話なんだけど、今度はいつものご飯じゃなくて、デートとして誘いたいんだ。来週の土曜の夜、恵比寿のワインバーはどうかな？気が進まなかったら遠慮なく断ってね。それで何も変わらないし、またいつも通りご飯行こう。
cases.note: 長い友人ほど「デートとして」とはっきり言うこと。曖昧だといつもの食事と区別がつかず、断る自由もなくなる。

cases.situation: 离婚两年，有个六岁的女儿，隔周的周末她在她妈妈那边。在探探上和一个女生聊了一周，挺投缘，想约她见面，也想提前说清楚我有孩子、时间不太自由。
cases.reply: 跟你聊天挺开心的，想约你当面喝杯咖啡。先说一下我的情况：我有个六岁的女儿，隔周的周末她在她妈妈那边，所以我比较方便的是10月10日周六下午，或者工作日的晚上。如果有孩子这一点让你觉得不合适，直接说就好，完全理解。
cases.note: 有孩子、时间受限的情况在见面前一句话说清，比见面后再说更尊重对方，也让对方更容易拒绝。

cases.situation: Second date with Priya is set for this Thursday, Oct 1, at a Thai place she picked. My boss just sent me to Denver Wednesday to Friday for a client issue. I don't want her to think I'm losing interest.
cases.reply: Bad news: work is sending me to Denver Wednesday to Friday, so I have to cancel Thursday, and I'm genuinely annoyed about it. I still really want to try your Thai place. Could we do Saturday Oct 3 or Tuesday Oct 6 instead? If neither works, send me a night that does.
cases.note: Cancel and rebook in the same message: a concrete new date is what shows you're still keen.

cases.situation: First date last night with Marcus from Hinge, a coffee that turned into a long walk. He was kind and easy to talk to, but I didn't feel much of a spark and I'm honestly not sure yet. He just texted 'Had a great time, would love to see you again!'
cases.reply: Thanks, Marcus, I had a really nice time too, and turning coffee into a walk was a good call. I'd be up for another low-key one, maybe a coffee next week, and see how it goes.
cases.note: Unsure is allowed: a warm, low-stakes yes without promising more. If you already know it's a no, use romantic-let-down instead.

cases.situation: I'm 64 and was widowed three years ago. A man in my Wednesday community choir, Gerald, always saves me a biscuit at the break and we talk about our gardens. I'd like to ask him for coffee, but I haven't asked anyone out since 1985.
cases.reply: Gerald, I've really enjoyed our gardening chats at the break. Would you like to have a coffee with me sometime, just the two of us? Saturday morning at the café by the garden centre, perhaps. And if not, no bother at all, I'll see you at choir either way.
cases.note: The shape is the same at any age: a specific plan and a real out. The out also protects the choir, which you both keep whatever he says.

cases.situation: 九月中去大理玩，在青旅认识了一个杭州的男生阿哲，一起爬了苍山，之后微信断断续续聊了两周，他说过杭州的秋天最好看。我在上海，10月16日周五去杭州出差，周六还能多待一天，想约他见面。
cases.reply: 阿哲，我10月16号周五去杭州出差，周六还会多待一天。想约你见一面：17号周六下午去西湖边走走，再找个地方喝杯东西，怎么样？爬苍山那天你说杭州的秋天最好看，正好验证一下。不方便也没关系，下次有机会再说。
cases.note: 异地的邀约：说清你本来就会在那边的时间，给一个具体安排，对方不会有“专门为我跑一趟”的压力，拒绝也容易。

cases.situation: I've been messaging Owen on a dating app for a week and I like him. He just suggested our first date be dinner that he cooks at his flat on Saturday. I want to meet him, but somewhere public for a first date, and I don't want to sound like I'm accusing him of anything.
cases.reply: That's a really sweet offer, and I'd love to meet you. For a first date I always keep it simple and out somewhere, so how about a coffee or a drink on Saturday afternoon instead? If it goes well, I'm holding you to that dinner another time.
cases.note: State it as your own habit, not a judgment of him; a decent person will say yes without fuss.

cases.situation: First date with Hana last night and I was 25 minutes late because my train broke down. She was really gracious about it, and we ended up talking for hours; she showed me photos of her lopsided first pots from her pottery class. I want to text her today, own the lateness lightly, and ask for a second date.
cases.reply: Thanks again for being so gracious about my train disaster last night. I had a really good time, and I'm still thinking about those lopsided first pots. I'd like to see you again, and this time I'll be the one waiting: dinner on Friday or Saturday?
cases.note: One light line on the lateness is enough; a long apology would make the text about your mistake instead of the date.

cases.situation: 和在羽毛球群认识的阿远约会了五次，每周都见，感觉很好，我已经不跟别人约了。但我看到他探探还开着，想确认我们是不是只和彼此约会，又不想弄得像逼他。打算这周六吃完饭当面说。
cases.reply: 跟你说个事哈。这几周跟你在一起我挺开心的，我现在也没在跟别人约会了。想问问你，我们要不要就只跟彼此约会？你要是还没想好，直接跟我说就行，我更想听真话。
cases.note: 先说自己的状态，再问一个清楚的问题，给对方真实的退路；不必提探探，他的回答本身就是答案。

cases.situation: 在相亲App上认识了程程，聊了五天挺投缘，还没见过面。她今天突然问我：“你是奔着结婚去的，还是先谈着看？”我32岁，确实想找能长期走下去的人，但不想还没见面就聊结婚把她吓到。
cases.reply: 问得好，我直说：我是想认真找一个能长期走下去的人，不是随便聊聊。不过合不合适，总得见了面、相处过才知道。这周六下午要不要一起喝杯咖啡？不方便也没关系，你定。
cases.note: 被直接问意图时，一句诚实的回答，然后落到一个具体、低压力的见面上。

cases.situation: 健身房认识的男生阿凯约我这周六晚上去酒吧喝一杯。我挺想跟他出去的，但我不喝酒，也更喜欢白天见面，不想在微信上解释太多。
cases.reply: 好呀，想跟你出去！不过我不太喝酒，周六下午找个地方喝咖啡、走走怎么样？周六不方便的话，换个时间也行。
cases.note: 答应的是他这个人，改的只是安排；不喝酒的原因不用第一次就解释。

cases.situation: I've had two dates with Nadia and we'd planned a third for Saturday. This morning she texted that her dad's been admitted to hospital after a fall, she's driving up to Leeds and needs to cancel. I want to reply kindly without making it about us, but I don't want her to think I've lost interest either.
cases.reply: Of course, don't give Saturday a second thought. I'm really sorry about your dad, and I hope the drive up to Leeds goes okay. Focus on him and your family, and whenever things settle, I'd love to pick Saturday up again. No need to reply to this.
cases.note: Put the date on hold, not on the table: one warm line about later, then let her be the one to come back to it.

cases.situation: I've bought coffee at the same bakery for months and Ana, who works the counter, always remembers my order and we chat about her film course. I want to ask her out without putting her on the spot at work, maybe with a note. I'm Leo, my number is 555-0142.
cases.reply: Hi Ana, I've really enjoyed our chats about your film course. If you'd ever like to get a coffee somewhere you're not the one making it, I'd love that. My number's 555-0142. If not, no need to reply, and I'll still be in for my usual with zero awkwardness. Leo
cases.note: Someone at work can't easily say no to a customer's face, so a note lets her answer in her own time, or not at all.

cases.situation: Saí com o Rafael há duas semanas, num bar em Pinheiros, e foi ótimo. Aí sumi porque o fechamento do trimestre no trabalho me engoliu, e ele mandou mensagem há dez dias perguntando se estava tudo bem; não respondi. Ainda quero vê-lo e quero retomar sem fazer drama.
cases.reply: Oi, Rafael! Te devo uma resposta faz dez dias, desculpa o sumiço: o fechamento do trimestre no trabalho me engoliu. Aquela noite em Pinheiros foi ótima e eu queria muito te ver de novo. Topa um café ou um chope no sábado à tarde? Se não fizer mais sentido pra você, tudo bem, eu entendo.
cases.note: Quando quem sumiu foi você: uma linha assumindo, um motivo curto, um convite concreto e uma saída fácil.

cases.situation: I've been chatting with Jonah on Hinge for a week. I use a wheelchair, it's in my profile photos, and he's been easy and curious about it. I want to suggest a drink at The Lantern on Thursday 8 October, which has step-free entry, and I'd rather not have a long logistics chat beforehand.
cases.reply: I'm enjoying this and I'd rather keep it going in person. How about a drink at The Lantern on Thursday 8 October? I tend to pick places that work for my chair so neither of us has to think about it on the night, and that one's step-free. If Thursday's no good, tell me a night that is.
cases.note: Choosing the venue yourself, with one line on why, sets the logistics without making them the topic of the date.
